[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-o6[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Property cards become the note title block: one title, a clear [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]species, and a docked rail on album, record, day, and period notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]On desktop Obsidian, every album note, record note, canonical daily[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note, and week, quarter, and year note opens on its property card, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and that card is the note's only visible title. The card leads with[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a species glyph tile and a kicker word (ALBUM, RECORD, DAY, WEEK, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]QUARTER, YEAR), so an album, a record, and a day can never be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]mistaken for each other, even in grayscale. The redundant H1, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]inline title, and nav line are hidden at render time, never deleted[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](except album H1s, which move into a bob-owned `title:` key). Every[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]failure restores native rendering.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]teardown, record a GO or NO-GO verdict with evidence on this phase bead,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and deploy the unused primitive.[/#D7D7AF]
